lessons.title: Lesson 1: PHP Basics & Hello World
lessons.html:
Your First PHP Script

PHP is a server-side scripting language designed for web development. Runs on server, generates HTML.

Basic Structure:

  • <?php ?> - PHP tags
  • echo - Output to browser
  • ; - Statement terminator
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<body>
<?php
  echo "Hello, PHP!";
  $name = "World";
  echo "<h2>Hello, $name!</h2>";
?>
</body>
</html>

Run: Save as index.php, open in browser via web server.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Variables & Data Types
lessons.html:
PHP Variables

Variables start with $. PHP is loosely typed - no need to declare type.

Types:

TypeExample
String$name = "John"
Integer$age = 25
Float$price = 19.99
Boolean$active = true
Array$fruits = ["apple", "banana"]
<?php
$name = "Alice";
$age = 25;
$height = 1.65;
$isStudent = true;

echo "Name: $name, Age: $age, Height: $height";
if ($isStudent) {
    echo " - Student";
}
?>

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Forms & $_POST/$_GET
lessons.html:
Handling Forms

PHP receives data from HTML forms via $_POST and $_GET.

<form method="POST" action="process.php">
  Name: <input type="text" name="username"><br>
  Email: <input type="email" name="email"><br>
  <input type="submit" value="Send">
</form>
<?php  // process.php
if ($_POST) {
    $username = $_POST["username"];
    $email = $_POST["email"];
    
    echo "<h2>Welcome, $username!</h2>";
    echo "Your email: $email";
}
?>

Security: Always validate and sanitize input!

lessons.title: Lesson 4: MySQL Connection
lessons.html:
Connecting to MySQL

PHP + MySQL = dynamic websites. Use PDO for modern database connections.

<?php
// Database config
$host = "localhost";
$dbname = "myDB";
$username = "root";
$password = "";

try {
    $pdo = new PDO("mysql:host=$host;dbname=$dbname", $username, $password);
    $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
    echo "Connected successfully";
} catch(PDOException $e) {
    echo "Connection failed: " . $e->getMessage();
}
?>

lessons.title: Lesson 5: CRUD Operations
lessons.html:
Create, Read, Update, Delete

Basic database operations with prepared statements (secure!).

Create (INSERT):

$stmt = $pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO users (name, email) VALUES (?, ?)");
$stmt->execute(["John", "john@example.com"]);

Read (SELECT):

$stmt = $pdo->query("SELECT * FROM users");
while ($row = $stmt->fetch()) {
    echo $row["name"] . " - " . $row["email"] . "<br>";
}
